properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: TrimRunA
properties.description: Trim length for run port A

properties.name: TrimRunB
properties.description: Trim length for run port B

properties.name: TrimBranch
properties.description: Trim length for the branch port

properties.name: BranchRadius
properties.description: Bend radius of the branch takeoff as it curves into the run. A face-mounted branch (one passing over or under the run) uses it for the elbow after its collar

properties.name: ReverseBranchBend
properties.description: Reverse the branch bend toward the opposite run leg

properties.name: Attachment
properties.description: How the branch joins the run. Side: through the side of the run. Face: the branch passes over or under the run, and joins it with a collar and a 90 degree elbow. Auto picks one from where the branch is drawn

properties.name: CollarRoll
properties.description: Face-mounted branch on a round run only: rolls the collar about the run towards the branch (SMACNA 'rolled 45 deg'); the elbow then turns that much less. 0 = collar straight up
